prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: game-ready transparent building sprite, one single cottage cutout for a fixed-camera cozy pixel-art 2.5D game. Reference 1 is the approved FOREST COTTAGE STYLE, reference 2 is the ACTUAL GAME CAMERA/SCALE reference only; ignore reference 2's crude geometric placeholder art. Draw ONLY one complete small cottage, centered with generous transparent margin, full roof, facade, a little right side wall, ground-contact foundation. No environment, terrain, background, trees, cliff, characters, animals, captions, watermark or UI.
Design: spider older sister's warm handmade book-and-thread workshop nestled at the foot of a mossy rock bank. Cozy small timber cottage with gently uneven lilac/slate patchwork shingle gable roof; honey amber round attic window and one warm side window; short timber porch with a clearly visible SINGLE front-right door, no second door. Warm cream plaster and dark wood framing. One very small bookshelf tucked against front-left wall, a basket of lavender yarn and a softly hanging pale-lilac ribbon. Keep the doorway and its bottom clear, not covered with props. Low mossy stone plinth. No large stairs baked into this sprite: at most one thin porch lip, actual steps will be 3D. No tall chimney or extravagant tower. Leave the right and left outer wall shapes clean for alpha masking. Soft welcoming design with plain legible forms; restrained details sized to read at approximately 350px displayed width. No faux-scary faces, pumpkins, gothic horror or sharp forms.
Camera is CRITICAL: only 25 degrees downward elevation, with a modest 15-20 degree horizontal three-quarter rotation revealing the right wall. Mostly front-facing, shallow roof visibility, upright walls. NOT a 45-degree isometric top-down building, NOT a high bird's-eye view. Paint the desired side angle INSIDE the sprite, rather than expecting the engine camera to orbit. Compact broad silhouette, width about 1.5 times height. Door should be large enough for a 1.6m tall game character, total cottage height about 4m and width about 6m. Base foot anchor at the center of the stone plinth bottom.
Style: delicate but crisp pixel clusters and dark plum outlines, same hand-painted pixel storybook feel as approved scene, no smooth 3D render or photoreal textures. Warm windows, muted purple roof, desaturated wooden walls; neutral gentle baked lighting so it can blend with game scene lighting. True transparent background, no cast shadow outside the building silhouette, no opaque colored matte.
